headline: Time well chosen.
intro: A meeting place for remarkable watches and the people who appreciate them. Discover independent sellers, considered auctions and a more transparent way to collect.
illustration: An illustrated mechanical watch, not a watch offered for sale
promise1Body: Buy from private sellers, established dealers and official brands. Beirut Time connects you; it does not sell watches.
promise2Body: Know the seller, the condition and the terms before making your next move.
promise3Body: Made for Lebanon, in English and Arabic. Thoughtful on your desk and in your hand.
platformBody: Live availability from each independent service. No listings or transactions are simulated here.
